description: Bitcraze Crazyflie 2.1 nano quad X (stock brushed 7 mm motors, 250 mAh LiPo). Thrust and battery coefficients are DERIVED from Bitcraze's published 2015 thrust-stand table; inertia and moment constant come from Bitcraze's MIT-licensed gz model, which reproduces Foerster 2015 values (primary PDF could not be retrieved in this session: ETH Research Collection HTTP 429/500).

BCSIM.meshLicense: meshes/ (Blender-made by Bitcraze) are inside the MIT-licensed repo; no separate mesh notice found. Candidate for import with MIT attribution after maintainer-notice check.

BCPWM.license: Web documentation; numeric measurements cited as facts with attribution (16-row table).
BCPWM.note: 2015 table: whole-vehicle thrust (g), battery voltage, current, PWM %, mean RPM. RPM fit published on page: thrust_g = 1.0942e-07 rpm^2 - 2.1059e-04 rpm + 1.5417e-01.

FOERSTER2015.citation: J. Foerster, System Identification of the Crazyflie 2.0 Nano Quadrocopter, BSc thesis, ETH Zurich, 2015

BCPWM_table_2015.notes: PWM 43.25 on the page is taken as a typo for 43.75. Thrust assumed to be whole-vehicle (four rotors); consistency check: hover of 29 g lands at 50-56 % PWM.

inertia.locator: model.sdf base link inertia; values attributed to FOERSTER2015

kf.locator: least-squares T_rotor = kf w^2 through origin on table rows 2-16, thrust/4 per rotor; relative RMS 2.9 %
kf.decision: D15: the measured Bitcraze thrust-stand fit is the primary kf

alternatives.note: Primary PDF unreadable (HTTP 429/500). At omega_max 2618 rad/s this gives T/W about 1.24 (1.27 with the model's 28.2 g), which conflicts with the measured table.

kf.openQuestion: The two kf values differ by 1.73x (measured 2.218e-8 vs 1.282e-8); unresolved until the Foerster 2015 thesis is read at the primary source.

tau_up.locator: no primary value retrieved; prior only. Identify from RPM-instrumented steps (see test_aerial_identifiability.py)

omega_max.locator: maxRotVelocity (table max 23882 rpm = 2501 rad/s at 93.75 % PWM, 3.30 V)

rotor_drag.locator: BCSIM uses the RotorS 8.06428e-05 (scaled for a 1.5 kg vehicle); not adopted

rotor_radius.locator: approx. 47 mm stock propeller; not retrieved from a primary source

drag_linear.locator: thesis reports a wind-tunnel drag matrix; values not retrieved

battery_v_full.locator: intercept of V = Voc - I R fit on table (near-full pack)

battery_resistance.locator: slope of V vs I fit; includes connector/wiring; RMS 0.015 V

battery_v_nominal.locator: voltage at which omega_max is quoted (assumed)

battery_efficiency.locator: shaft power 4 km kf w^3 / (V I) at the 93.75 % row
